timeline.text: A first-grader's worksheets kept repeating — the same six colors, the same pig, three days running.
The AI-written lessons repeated too: one topic ran fourteen days straight.
Now every worksheet checks a rolling memory of what each child already saw, stored in Supabase.
The AI's daily lessons follow the same rule now — no repeating recent words or topics.
The review track now moves on after ten days, instead of stalling on the same step.
